rows.title: Check the backup
rows.summary: Verify the saved change and report where it is preserved.
rows.details: Inspect the source and remote history. Return the commit link or the missing preservation step.

rows.title: Check feedback delivery
rows.summary: Confirm the next received reply contains the selected items and their notes.
rows.details: A saved draft does not prove delivery. Compare the received feedback with the review choices.

rows.title: Inspect repeated work
rows.summary: Find one supported explanation for repeated work and propose one bounded improvement.
rows.details: Check the evidence before recommending a change. Report uncertainty when the source is incomplete.
